generic.Defined scope/population: Open premium, claims and commission items for one counterparty legal entity eligible for treaty netting
generic.In-scope period: The technical account period being netted, up to the settlement cut-off for that treaty
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each item carries counterparty, settlement currency, treaty reference, balance direction and dispute flag
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Net debit or credit from the netting routine equals the sum of contributing technical account lines
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Netting run output saved with run timestamp and the treaty netting clause extract attached
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items excluded as disputed or on a repayment plan are listed with the reason for exclusion
generic.Test population: All netting groups created in the settlement period across counterparties
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero groups mixing currency or legal entity and zero unexplained variance to the gross line sum
generic.Exception handling path: Failed netting groups are unwound and referred to the Reinsurance Ops Manager for re-run
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Offset permitted by clause, single entity, single currency, net figure agrees to gross lines
generic.Evidence location: Netting run report and clause extract stored against the treaty record in the reinsurance system

steps.title: Open the netting clause in the treaty wording held in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Locate the treaty record and open the wording attachment in the reinsurance administration system
Read the netting clause and confirm offset is permitted across premium, claims and commission
Done when the permitted offset scope is recorded on the netting worksheet
verify: Check the clause extract is attached to the netting worksheet
Pass when the permitted offset categories match the categories being netted

steps.title: Extract open debit and credit balances by counterparty from Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Run the open-items extract in Sapiens ReinsurancePro filtered to the counterparty and account period
Export debit and credit balances with treaty reference, currency and legal entity columns
Done when the extract is saved to the netting workbook in Microsoft Excel
verify: Agree the extract total to the counterparty open balance shown in the reinsurance system
Pass when both totals match to the cent

steps.title: Restrict the offset set to one legal entity and one settlement currency in Microsoft Excel
sop: Group the extracted items by counterparty legal entity and settlement currency
Remove any item whose entity or currency differs from the netting group being built
Done when every remaining item shares the same entity and currency
verify: Count distinct entity and currency values within each netting group
Pass when each group returns exactly one entity and one currency

steps.title: Exclude disputed and repayment-plan items in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter the open items for the Disputed flag and for active repayment-plan links
Remove those items from the netting pool and list them on the exclusions tab with the reason
Done when the exclusions list is complete and the remaining pool is clean
verify: Cross-check the netting pool against the disputed-items report for the counterparty
Pass when no disputed or plan item appears in the netting pool

steps.title: Run the netting routine for the counterparty in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Select the cleaned item set and execute the netting routine for the account period
Capture the resulting net debit or credit position and the run reference
Done when the netting run completes with a net position and a run reference
verify: Confirm the run reference is recorded on the netting worksheet
Pass when the routine completes with no rejected items

steps.title: Agree the net position to the underlying technical account lines in Microsoft Excel
sop: Sum the contributing technical account lines by category in the netting workbook
Compare the sum to the net debit or credit produced by the netting routine
Done when the two figures agree or the difference is explained and cleared
verify: Recompute the line sum independently from the source extract
Pass when the recomputed sum equals the system net position

steps.title: Stamp the netting reference on each contributing item in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Apply the netting run reference to every open item included in the group
Confirm the gross items remain visible and traceable after the offset is applied
Done when every contributing item carries the netting reference
verify: Query the netted items and check the reference field is populated on all of them
Pass when no contributing item is missing a netting reference

steps.title: Submit the netting pack to the Reinsurance Ops Manager for approval
sop: Review the clause extract, the exclusions list and the net position agreement
Challenge any group where the offset basis or the exclusion reasoning is unclear
Done when the netting group is approved and released for settlement
verify: Check the approval is recorded against the netting run reference
Pass when every released netting group carries a recorded approval

generic.Defined scope/population: All bank receipts landing on reinsurance settlement accounts awaiting application to open statements
generic.In-scope period: The current cash application cycle from the last applied bank statement to today
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each receipt carries payer, value date, currency, amount and remittance reference before application
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total receipts applied plus residual suspense equals total cash received for the cycle
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remittance advice and application posting saved against the statement with the posting timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short payments and unallocated residuals are logged with the variance code or suspense reason
generic.Test population: All receipts applied to open statements in the cash application cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every applied receipt links to a statement line and no receipt ages past the suspense threshold
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched receipts route to reinsurance suspense and onto the daily unallocated cash list
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Payer matched, allocation supported by remittance advice, statement status updated to Settled or Part-Settled
generic.Evidence location: Receipt application record in the reinsurance administration system with the remittance advice attached

steps.title: Pull the bank remittance advice for the receipt from the ERP general ledger cash module
sop: Open the cash receipt in the ERP general ledger and retrieve the attached remittance advice
Note the payer name, reference, currency, amount and value date
Done when the remittance details are captured against the receipt record
verify: Compare captured details to the bank statement line
Pass when payer, amount, currency and value date all agree

steps.title: Match the payer to the counterparty on the open statement in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Search open statements by counterparty name, treaty reference and currency
Confirm the payer on the advice is the counterparty or its placing broker on the statement
Done when the receipt is linked to a candidate counterparty account
verify: Check the counterparty static record for the payer name or broker relationship
Pass when the payer is a recognised payer for that counterparty

steps.title: Allocate the receipt to statement lines in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Apply the receipt to the lines named on the remittance advice where allocation detail is given
Where no detail is given, apply to the oldest open statement lines for that treaty
Done when the full receipt value is allocated or a residual is identified
verify: Re-add the allocated line values and compare to the receipt amount
Pass when allocations plus residual equal the receipt amount exactly

steps.title: Split part-payments pro-rata only on written counterparty instruction
sop: Check for a written allocation instruction from the counterparty before splitting a part-payment
Attach the instruction to the receipt record in the reinsurance administration system
Done when every pro-rata split has an attached written instruction
verify: List pro-rata split receipts for the cycle and check each for an attachment
Pass when no pro-rata split lacks a written instruction

steps.title: Post short payments under tolerance to the settlement variance account in the ERP general ledger
sop: Compare the applied amount to the statement balance and compute the shortfall
Where the shortfall is within tolerance, code it to the agreed settlement variance account
Done when the variance is posted and the statement line is fully cleared
verify: Check each variance posting against the published tolerance threshold
Pass when no variance above tolerance has been written off

steps.title: Confirm the statement status flips to Settled or Part-Settled in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Refresh the statement record after posting the application
Confirm the status has moved from Open to Settled or Part-Settled
Done when the status reflects the cash applied
verify: Re-run the open statements list for the counterparty
Pass when no fully paid statement still shows status Open

steps.title: Review the unapplied cash residual against the suspense ageing threshold
sop: List receipts still fully or partly unapplied at the end of the cycle
Age each against the suspense threshold and assign an investigation owner
Done when every unapplied residual has an owner and a target clear date
verify: Compare the unapplied list to the reinsurance suspense balance
Pass when the two agree and no item exceeds the ageing threshold unowned

generic.Defined scope/population: All reinsurance settlement disbursements released in the cycle and awaiting bank confirmation
generic.In-scope period: From the payment release date to the contractual settlement due date for each disbursement
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment reference, value date, amount, currency and beneficiary account present on the confirmation
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmed disbursement amounts agree line by line to the approved payment request total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bank confirmation attached to the payment record with the confirmation date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disbursements without a confirmation by cut-off are logged and chased with the bank
generic.Test population: All disbursements marked Confirmed in the reinsurance administration system for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero disbursements marked Confirmed without an attached bank confirmation
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or mismatched confirmations are escalated to the Accountant and the payment stays unconfirmed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reference matched, value date on or before due date, amount and beneficiary agreed to static data
generic.Evidence location: Bank confirmation attached to the disbursement record in the reinsurance administration system

steps.title: Retrieve the bank confirmation for the released settlement from the ERP general ledger
sop: Open the payment run in the ERP general ledger and download the bank confirmation or payment reference
Match the confirmation to the payment instruction number raised for the settlement
Done when the confirmation is linked to the correct payment instruction
verify: Compare the instruction number on the confirmation to the reinsurance payment record
Pass when the two references are identical

steps.title: Verify the confirmed value date against the contractual settlement due date
sop: Read the value date from the bank confirmation
Compare it to the contractual due date held on the settlement schedule
Done when the value date is confirmed on or before the due date or a breach is logged
verify: Recheck the due date against the treaty settlement clause
Pass when the value date does not fall after the contractual due date

steps.title: Agree the confirmed amount and currency to the approved payment request in Microsoft Excel
sop: List the approved payment request lines alongside the confirmed amounts
Compare amount and currency line by line and note any difference
Done when every line agrees or a difference is explained and coded
verify: Total both columns and compare the sums
Pass when the confirmed total equals the approved request total

steps.title: Check the beneficiary account against the counterparty static data record
sop: Open the counterparty static data record in the reinsurance administration system
Compare the beneficiary account on the confirmation to the stored bank details
Done when the beneficiary account is confirmed as the account on file
verify: Check the static data change log for any recent unverified bank detail change
Pass when the paid account matches the verified account on file

steps.title: Mark the disbursement as Confirmed in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Set the disbursement status to Confirmed and record the bank confirmation reference
Enter the confirmation date against the payment record
Done when the status and reference are saved on the payment record
verify: Reopen the payment record and read back the status and reference
Pass when status is Confirmed and the reference is populated

steps.title: Attach the bank confirmation to the payment record for audit
sop: Upload the bank confirmation document to the disbursement record
Name the attachment with the payment reference and value date
Done when the confirmation is attached and openable from the payment record
verify: Run the confirmed-disbursements list and check for attachments
Pass when no Confirmed disbursement lacks an attached bank confirmation

steps.title: Chase unconfirmed disbursements with the bank before the cycle cut-off
sop: List disbursements released but not yet confirmed at the cut-off
Raise a query with the bank quoting the instruction number and value date
Done when each unconfirmed item has a chase reference and target date
verify: Recheck the unconfirmed list at the next cycle
Pass when every carried-forward item shows a chase entry

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force treaties requiring dated cash settlement schedules for the coming account periods
generic.In-scope period: The next rolling settlement horizon covering every account period open under the treaty
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each schedule row carries treaty, account period, currency, due date and instalment type
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of scheduled treaties equals the count of treaties on the in-force list
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published settlement calendar version saved with the generation date and treaty extract used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties with unclear or missing settlement clauses are logged and referred for wording review
generic.Test population: All settlement schedule rows generated for the current period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every in-force treaty has at least one dated row and no due date falls on a non-business day
generic.Exception handling path: Treaties failing schedule generation are listed for manual scheduling by the Reinsurance Analyst
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Due date equals period end plus contractual grace days adjusted for currency business days
generic.Evidence location: Settlement calendar published in the reinsurance administration system with the Excel working retained

steps.title: Extract the in-force treaty list from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the in-force treaty extract at the schedule generation date
Include treaty reference, underwriting year, settlement currency and account period frequency
Done when the extract is saved as the scheduling population
verify: Compare the extract count to the in-force treaty count in the system
Pass when the two counts agree

steps.title: Read the settlement clause for each treaty in the treaty repository
sop: Open each treaty wording in the treaty repository and locate the settlement clause
Record account period frequency and the days-after-close payment window
Done when frequency and payment window are captured for every treaty
verify: Spot-check captured terms against the wording for a sample of treaties
Pass when the sampled terms match the wording exactly

steps.title: Compute due dates as period end plus grace days in Microsoft Excel
sop: Calculate period end for each account period from the treaty frequency
Add the contractual grace days to derive the raw due date
Done when every account period has a computed raw due date
verify: Recompute a sample of due dates by hand from period end and grace days
Pass when the sampled recomputed dates match the schedule

steps.title: Adjust due dates for non-business days in the settlement currency
sop: Apply the settlement currency business day calendar to each raw due date
Roll dates falling on weekends or currency holidays to the next business day
Done when no due date sits on a non-business day
verify: Test each due date against the currency holiday calendar
Pass when zero due dates land on a non-business day

steps.title: Split the schedule by settlement currency in Microsoft Excel
sop: Create a separate schedule row per settlement currency for multicurrency treaties
Carry the treaty reference and account period onto each currency row
Done when every currency permitted by the treaty has its own dated row
verify: Compare currency rows per treaty to the currencies named in the currency clause
Pass when every permitted currency has a row

steps.title: Flag deposit and premium-in-advance instalments as separate schedule rows
sop: Identify treaties carrying deposit premium or premium-in-advance instalments
Schedule each instalment date as its own row with the instalment type recorded
Done when every instalment date is separately scheduled
verify: Compare instalment rows to the instalment table in the treaty wording
Pass when instalment count and dates match the wording

steps.title: Publish the schedule to the settlement calendar in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Load the completed schedule into the settlement calendar
Version the published calendar with the generation date
Done when the calendar shows the new version as active
verify: Cross-check the in-force treaty list against the published calendar
Pass when every in-force treaty has at least one dated settlement row

steps.title: Review the published schedule with the Reinsurance Ops Manager
sop: Review treaties with unusual frequencies, long grace periods or missing clauses
Confirm the exception list has an owner and a resolution date
Done when the schedule is signed off for the period
verify: Check the sign-off is recorded against the calendar version
Pass when the active calendar version carries a recorded sign-off

generic.Defined scope/population: All treaty and counterparty combinations with a closed technical account period awaiting a statement
generic.In-scope period: The closed technical account period being stated, with no bookings pending for that period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Statement header carries treaty reference, underwriting year, account period, currency and due date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Statement net total equals the reinsurance subledger open balance for the same treaty and period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated statement stored with generation timestamp and the subledger extract used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Periods still flagged Open or with pending bookings are listed and excluded from generation
generic.Test population: All settlement statements generated for the account period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero statements generated for an Open period and zero net totals differing from the subledger
generic.Exception handling path: Statements failing the subledger agreement are held back and referred to the Accountant
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium, commission, brokerage, claims and portfolio movements shown as separate lines with correct sign
generic.Evidence location: Statement record in the reinsurance administration system with the agreement working attached

steps.title: Confirm the technical account period is closed in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Check the account period status for each treaty in scope
Confirm no premium, claim or commission bookings remain pending for the period
Done when every in-scope period shows status Closed
verify: Run the pending-bookings report for the period
Pass when the report returns zero pending items for in-scope treaties

steps.title: Generate the technical account statement in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Run the statement generation routine for the treaty, counterparty and account period
Capture the statement number produced for each treaty
Done when a statement number exists for every in-scope treaty
verify: Compare generated statement count to the in-scope treaty count
Pass when the counts agree

steps.title: Verify the statement shows each component as a separate line
sop: Open each generated statement and check for premium, ceding commission and brokerage lines
Check claims paid and portfolio movement lines are present where applicable
Done when all applicable component lines are present and labelled
verify: Compare the line set to the standard statement layout
Pass when no applicable component is rolled into another line

steps.title: Agree the statement net balance to the subledger open items in Microsoft Excel
sop: Extract subledger open items for the same treaty, counterparty and period
Sum the open items and compare the total to the statement net balance
Done when the two figures agree or the difference is investigated and cleared
verify: Recompute the subledger sum independently from the extract
Pass when the recomputed sum equals the statement net total

steps.title: Check the statement header fields in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Read the header for treaty reference, underwriting year, account period, currency and due date
Correct any header field that does not match the treaty record
Done when every header field matches the treaty and settlement schedule
verify: Compare header currency and due date to the settlement calendar row
Pass when header values match the calendar entry

steps.title: Confirm the netted balance direction follows the technical account sign convention
sop: Check whether the net balance is presented as payable to us or payable by us
Compare the direction to the sign of the underlying technical account result
Done when the direction on the statement matches the underlying balance
verify: Sample statements with a reversed direction against the prior period
Pass when no statement shows a direction inconsistent with its net balance

steps.title: Release the statement set for issue and file the agreement working
sop: Attach the subledger agreement working to each released statement
Set the statement status to Released ready for despatch
Done when every agreed statement is Released with the working attached
verify: Run the released statement list and check attachments
Pass when no released statement lacks an attached agreement working

generic.Defined scope/population: All released settlement statements due for despatch to brokers and reinsurers this cycle
generic.In-scope period: From statement release to the contractual notice deadline ahead of the settlement due date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Advice states due date, settlement currency, remittance bank details and recipient contact
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of advices despatched equals the count of released statements for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Despatch date and delivery channel recorded against each statement with the sent advice retained
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Statements with no valid contact on the security schedule are logged and referred for data fix
generic.Test population: All settlement advices issued in the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero advices without a recorded despatch date and zero issued after the due date
generic.Exception handling path: Undeliverable advices are re-routed via the Reinsurer Exchange and the failure is logged
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Addressed to the security schedule contact with technical account detail attached and due date stated
generic.Evidence location: Despatch record and sent advice attached to the statement in the reinsurance administration system

steps.title: Pull the recipient contacts from the treaty security schedule in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the security schedule for each treaty with a released statement
Take the recorded broker or reinsurer accounting contact, not a personal mailbox
Done when every statement has a named schedule contact
verify: Check each contact against the security schedule record
Pass when no advice is addressed to a contact absent from the schedule

steps.title: Attach the supporting technical account detail to each advice
sop: Export the premium, commission and claims line detail for the statement
Attach the detail to the advice so the counterparty can reconcile it
Done when every advice carries its supporting detail
verify: Open a sample of prepared advices and check the attachment
Pass when the attached detail totals to the statement net balance

steps.title: State due date, currency and remittance bank details on the advice
sop: Populate the advice with the settlement due date and settlement currency
Add the remittance bank details held for that currency on our static data
Done when all three fields appear on the face of the advice
verify: Compare the stated bank details to the approved receiving account list
Pass when the details match an approved receiving account

steps.title: Issue the advice through the Reinsurer Exchange or Microsoft Teams and email
sop: Send via the Reinsurer Exchange where the counterparty is connected
Send by email to the schedule contact where the Exchange is not available
Done when every advice has been transmitted on one of the two channels
verify: Check transmission receipts or Exchange delivery status
Pass when every advice shows a successful delivery status

steps.title: Confirm issue falls within the contractual notice period
sop: Compare the despatch date to the notice period stated in the settlement clause
Escalate any advice at risk of breaching the notice period before despatch
Done when every advice is issued inside the notice window or an exception is logged
verify: Test despatch date against due date less notice days for each advice
Pass when no advice breaches the notice window without a logged exception

steps.title: Record despatch date and channel against the statement
sop: Enter the despatch date and delivery channel on the statement record
Confirm the dunning clock has started from the recorded despatch date
Done when despatch metadata is saved on every issued statement
verify: Run the issued statements list and check despatch fields
Pass when no issued statement is missing a despatch date

steps.title: Handle bounced or rejected advices and re-issue
sop: Review delivery failures and identify the cause as contact, format or channel
Correct the contact record and re-issue the advice
Done when every failed advice has been re-issued and delivered
verify: Re-check delivery status for the re-issued advices
Pass when no advice remains in a failed delivery state

generic.Defined scope/population: All settlements denominated in a currency other than the entity functional currency
generic.In-scope period: The settlement cycle from technical account close to the payment or receipt value date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Settlement currency, rate basis, applied rate, rate date and rate source stored on each settlement
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Functional currency posting equals settlement currency amount times the applied rate
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rate evidence and conversion working retained with the rate date and source reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Settlements where the treaty rate basis is unclear are logged and referred for wording review
generic.Test population: All multicurrency settlements booked in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every settlement stores rate, rate date and source and no rate is dated after the value date
generic.Exception handling path: Settlements with a missing or stale rate are held and escalated to the Accountant before posting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Treaty rate basis applied, FX difference booked to realised FX and not to premium
generic.Evidence location: Conversion working held in Microsoft Excel and attached to the settlement in the reinsurance system

steps.title: Identify the settlement currency from the treaty in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Read the currency clause on the treaty record for the settlement currency
Compare it to the currency of the technical account being settled
Done when the settlement currency is confirmed against the technical account
verify: Check the technical account currency field against the treaty currency clause
Pass when the two agree or the difference is documented

steps.title: Determine the contractual rate basis for the treaty
sop: Identify whether the treaty specifies a fixed rate, rate of the day or period average
Record the basis on the settlement working rather than accepting the default system rate
Done when the rate basis is recorded for every multicurrency settlement
verify: Compare the recorded basis to the treaty conversion clause
Pass when the recorded basis matches the clause

steps.title: Retrieve the applicable rate from the approved FX rate table
sop: Look up the rate for the currency pair on the required rate date
Reject any rate dated after the settlement value date
Done when a valid dated rate is selected for each settlement
verify: Compare rate date to value date for every settlement
Pass when no rate date is later than its value date

steps.title: Record rate, rate date and source on the settlement record
sop: Enter the applied rate, rate date and rate source against the settlement
Confirm the fields are stored so the conversion can be reperformed later
Done when all three fields are saved on every settlement
verify: Query multicurrency settlements for null rate metadata
Pass when the query returns zero rows

steps.title: Book the FX difference to realised FX in the ERP general ledger
sop: Compute the difference between the technical account rate and the settlement date rate
Post the difference to the realised FX account and not to premium
Done when the FX difference is posted to the correct account
verify: Inspect the postings for any FX difference coded to a premium account
Pass when no FX difference sits in a premium account

steps.title: Confirm the functional currency posting equals amount times rate in Microsoft Excel
sop: Recompute settlement currency amount multiplied by the applied rate
Compare the result to the functional currency amount posted to the ledger
Done when the recomputation agrees to the ledger posting
verify: Run the recomputation across all settlements in the cycle
Pass when every settlement agrees within rounding tolerance

steps.title: File the conversion working against the settlement
sop: Save the Excel conversion working with rate, basis and source shown
Attach it to the settlement record in the reinsurance administration system
Done when every multicurrency settlement carries an attached working
verify: Sample settlements and open the attached working
Pass when the working reproduces the posted functional amount

generic.Defined scope/population: All confirmed disbursements awaiting matching to the settlement statement they were raised against
generic.In-scope period: The settlement cycle covering the statement due date and the disbursement value date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disbursement amount, currency, value date and statement reference present on both sides
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disbursement amount equals statement balance plus explained charges, FX and short payment
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bank confirmation and statement attached to the matched item with the match timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unexplained differences above tolerance are logged to the query log with an owner
generic.Test population: All disbursement to statement matches completed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Both sides show status Settled and no unexplained difference above tolerance remains
generic.Exception handling path: Differences above tolerance stay open and route to the settlement query process
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Amount, currency and value date matched with each difference coded to charges, FX or short payment
generic.Evidence location: Matched item record in the reinsurance administration system with both documents attached

steps.title: Retrieve the confirmed disbursement and its statement in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Open the confirmed disbursement and read the statement reference it was raised against
Open the corresponding settlement statement record
Done when both records are open and linked by reference
verify: Check the statement reference on the disbursement matches the statement number
Pass when the references are identical

steps.title: Match amount, currency and value date between the two records
sop: Compare the disbursement amount and currency to the statement net balance
Compare the value date to the contractual settlement due date
Done when the comparison result and any difference are recorded
verify: Recompute the difference between the two amounts
Pass when the difference is zero or fully explained in the next step

steps.title: Explain and code differences in Microsoft Excel
sop: Classify each difference as bank charges, FX movement or short payment
Code each classified difference to its correct ledger account
Done when every difference has a classification and an account code
verify: Sum the coded differences and compare to the total variance
Pass when coded differences fully account for the variance

steps.title: Confirm brokerage deducted at source agrees to the statement brokerage line
sop: Identify brokerage withheld by the broker from the remittance
Compare it to the brokerage line on the settlement statement
Done when the withheld brokerage agrees or the difference is queried
verify: Recompute brokerage at the treaty brokerage rate on the premium line
Pass when the recomputed brokerage equals the deducted amount

steps.title: Clear the matched statement lines in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Apply the match so the statement lines clear from open items
Confirm both the disbursement and the statement show status Settled
Done when the matched lines no longer appear in the open-items ageing
verify: Re-run the open-items ageing for the counterparty
Pass when the matched lines are absent from the ageing

steps.title: Attach the bank confirmation and the statement to the matched item
sop: Upload the bank confirmation and the settlement statement to the matched record
Record the match date and the matching user
Done when both documents are attached to the matched item
verify: Sample matched items and open both attachments
Pass when no matched item is missing either document

steps.title: Route unexplained differences above tolerance to the query log
sop: Identify matches where residual difference exceeds the tolerance threshold
Raise a query log entry with owner, counterparty and target resolution date
Done when every above-tolerance residual has an open query entry
verify: Compare above-tolerance residuals to open query log entries
Pass when each residual has a matching query entry

generic.Defined scope/population: All ceded premium payable balances agreed with reinsurers or brokers and due for payment this run
generic.In-scope period: The payment run cycle up to the contractual settlement due date for each ceded balance
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee, beneficiary bank details, currency, amount and treaty account-period reference all present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Payment file total equals the agreed ceded payable total on the approved payment request
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved payment request, sanctions result and release confirmation retained with timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sanctions hits and bank detail mismatches are logged with the hold or clear decision
generic.Test population: All ceded premium payments released in the payment run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every payee is screened before release and no payment shares preparer and approver
generic.Exception handling path: Screening hits and unverified bank changes stop release and escalate to the Reinsurance Ops Manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Balance agreed, payee screened, bank details verified, dual approval obtained above threshold
generic.Evidence location: Payment request and release evidence held on the ceded accounting platform payment record

steps.title: Confirm the ceded premium payable balance on the ceded accounting platform
sop: Extract the ceded premium payable balance by reinsurer and treaty account period
Confirm the balance has been agreed with the reinsurer or placing broker
Done when each balance carries evidence of counterparty agreement
verify: Check the agreement correspondence attached to each payable balance
Pass when no unagreed balance is included in the payment run

steps.title: Screen the payee against the sanctions list before raising the request
sop: Submit the reinsurer or broker payee for sanctions screening
Hold any payee returning a hit until the hit is investigated and cleared
Done when every payee has a recorded screening result
verify: Compare the payee list to the screening results log
Pass when every payee in the run has a cleared screening result

steps.title: Verify beneficiary bank details against counterparty static data
